title: Pedir direcciones
description: Vas caminando por una calle del centro y no encuentras el Museo de Historia. Detén a un transeúnte, pregunta cómo llegar y si está lejos.
objective: Detén a un transeúnte y pregunta cómo llegar al Museo de Historia; aclara que vas caminando y pregunta cuánto se tarda más o menos.
scene_context: Estás en una calle del centro de la ciudad. Ves a una persona local que parece poder ayudarte.
example_conversation:
User: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the History Museum?
Local: Sure! It's not far. Are you driving or walking?
User: I'm walking.
Local: Go straight for two blocks, then turn left. It's on your right.

title: Pedir ayuda en una tienda
description: No encuentras la vitamina C de 1000 mg en una farmacia grande y un empleado se acerca a ayudarte. Pídele ayuda con la marca y la presentación.
objective: Explica al empleado que no encuentras la vitamina C de 1000 mg y pídele ayuda, y pregunta también si tienen la marca que buscas.
scene_context: Estás en una farmacia grande. No encuentras lo que buscas y un empleado se acerca para ayudarte.
example_conversation:
Employee: Can I help you find something?
User: Yes, do you have Vitamin C in 1000mg tablets?
Employee: We have the store brand right here.
User: Do you carry the 'NatureHealth' brand specifically?

title: Saludar y presentarse
description: Estás en una sala con gente nueva y quieres presentarte con naturalidad. Da tu nombre y origen, di a qué te dedicas y busca un conocido en común.
objective: Preséntate con tu nombre y de dónde eres, di a qué te dedicas y una cosa que te guste; después haz dos preguntas para conocer al otro e intenta descubrir si tenéis un conocido en común.
scene_context: Estás en un evento con mucha gente. Todos llevan una etiqueta con su nombre y tú no conoces a nadie.
expected_outcome_indicator: Introduction with name, origin, and interest completed
example_conversation:
Person: Hi there!
User: Hello! My name is Ana. I'm from Colombia.
Person: Nice to meet you, Ana.
User: I enjoy hiking on weekends. What about you?
Person: I love reading.

title: Conocer a alguien en una fiesta
description: Una fiesta con gente que no conoces y quieres romper el hielo. Preséntate, pregunta a qué se dedica tu interlocutor y cómo conoce a los anfitriones.
objective: Preséntate con tu nombre y de dónde eres, pregunta a tu interlocutor a qué se dedica y averigua cómo conoce a los anfitriones de la fiesta.
scene_context: Estás en una fiesta de un amigo en común. No conoces a casi nadie y buscas con quién hablar.
expected_outcome_indicator: Introduction made and connection to host established
example_conversation:
User: Hi, do you mind if I join you?
Guest: Not at all! I'm Tom.
User: Nice to meet you, Tom. I'm Leo. How do you know Juan?
Guest: We work together. And you?
User: We're old friends from college.

title: Preguntar la hora a un desconocido
description: Esperas el autobús en una parada y no llevas reloj. Pregunta la hora a un desconocido, dale las gracias y averigua cuánto tarda el próximo bus.
objective: Pregunta la hora a la persona que espera contigo en la parada, dale las gracias y aprovecha para preguntar cuánto tarda el próximo autobús.
scene_context: Estás en una parada de autobús esperando. Hablas con una persona desconocida que está también esperando.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student asks for the time and thanks the person
example_conversation:
Person: Hello there!
User: Hi, excuse me. What time is it?
Person: It's 2 o'clock.
User: Thank you!
Person: You're welcome.

title: Reservar una mesa en un restaurante
description: Quieres reservar la cena del viernes en un restaurante con encanto. Llama, reserva mesa para cuatro a las nueve y pregunta si hay terraza.
objective: Reserva una mesa para cuatro el viernes a las nueve a tu nombre, pregunta si hay terraza y confirma la reserva antes de colgar.
scene_context: Llamas a un restaurante italiano con las manos ocupadas: tienes que apuntar la reserva.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student books a table for 4 people on Saturday at 7pm under the name García
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon, La Marisquería restaurant. How can I help you?
User: Hello, I want to book a table for four people, please.
Person: Yes, certainly. What day?
User: Saturday at 7 o'clock.
Person: What name is the reservation under?
User: García.

title: Pedir ayuda sobre un dolor en la farmacia
description: Te duele la espalda desde ayer y necesitas algo en la farmacia. Explica el dolor, pregunta cada cuántas horas tomarlo y si da sueño.
objective: Explica en la farmacia que te duele la espalda desde ayer, pide algo para el dolor y pregunta cada cuántas horas tomarlo y si da sueño.
scene_context: Estás en la farmacia con dolor de espalda. Hay cola y el farmacéutico te atiende rápido.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student describes headache, asks for medicine recommendation and price
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning. Can I help you?
User: I have a headache. Do you have aspirin?
Person: Yes, we do. This one is very good.
User: How much is it?
Person: It's 5 euros.
User: Thank you very much.

title: Comprar un billete de autobús
description: Viajas a Manchester el sábado por la mañana y no quieres perder el bus. Compra el billete de ida y vuelta, pregunta la hora y el andén.
objective: Compra un billete de ida y vuelta a Manchester para el sábado por la mañana, pregunta la hora de salida y desde qué andén sale el autobús.
scene_context: Estás en la taquilla de la estación de autobuses con la mochila al hombro.
expected_outcome_indicator: Purchases a bus ticket to Barcelona on Monday at 2 PM and confirms the price.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! Where would you like to go?
User: I want a ticket to Barcelona, please.
Person: When do you want to travel?
User: Monday at two o'clock.
Person: That is twelve euros.
User: Okay, I take it.

title: Pedir información sobre una casa en alquiler
description: Has visto el anuncio de un piso en alquiler y llamas para informarte. Pregunta el precio, los gastos incluidos, las habitaciones y cuándo visitarlo.
objective: Pregunta por teléfono el precio del alquiler y si incluye los gastos, cuántas habitaciones tiene el piso y cuándo puedes visitarlo.
scene_context: Ves un anuncio de piso en el tablón del barrio y llamas al número.
expected_outcome_indicator: Inquires about the apartment's bedrooms, bathroom, and monthly rent price.
example_conversation:
Person: Welcome! Do you like the apartment?
User: Yes, it is nice. How many bedrooms does it have?
Person: It has two bedrooms and one bathroom.
User: What is the rent per month?
Person: Five hundred euros per month.
User: That is good. Thank you.

title: Ordenar comida en una cafetería
description: Entras en una cafetería pequeña por la mañana con hambre. Pide un café con leche y un cruasán en la barra y pregunta cuánto es.
objective: Pide al camarero un café con leche y un cruasán, y pregunta cuánto cuesta en total antes de pagar en la barra.
scene_context: Estás en una pequeña cafetería por la mañana. Hablas con el camarero detrás del mostrador.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student orders breakfast items and asks for the price
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning! What can I have for you?
User: I want a coffee with milk, two toasts and an orange juice, please.
Person: Perfect! That's 8 euros in total.
User: Thank you!

title: Pedir la cuenta en un restaurante
description: La cena ha terminado y quieres cerrarla sin prisas. Pide la cuenta, pregunta si puedes pagar con tarjeta, pide un postre para llevar y deja propina.
objective: Pide la cuenta al terminar la cena, pregunta si puedes pagar con tarjeta, pide un postre para llevar y no te olvides de dejar propina.
scene_context: Termináis de cenar y el camarero retira los platos con prisa: se acerca el cierre.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student asks for the bill and confirms the price.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! Did you enjoy your meal?
User: Yes, thank you. Can I have the bill, please?
Person: Of course. That's 25 euros.
User: Okay. Thank you very much!
Person: You're welcome. Have a nice day!

title: Comprar un libro en una librería
description: Buscas un libro de historia para regalar en una librería de barrio. Pregunta el precio, valora la edición de bolsillo si pasa de 25 € y resuelve la reserva.
objective: Pide un libro de historia para regalo, pregunta el precio, si pasa de 25 € pregunta por la edición de bolsillo, pide reservarlo si no lo tienen y pregunta cuándo llega.
scene_context: Entras en una librería grande buscando un regalo con un presupuesto ajustado.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully finds and prices a book.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! Welcome to the bookshop. Can I help you?
User: Hi. Do you have 'The Little Prince'?
Person: Yes, we do. It's on that shelf over there.
User: How much is it?
Person: It's £8.99.
User: Thank you!

title: Preguntar por el horario de cierre de una piscina
description: Quieres empezar a nadar y llamas a la piscina municipal. Saca toda la información: cierre, entrada diaria, clases, gorro y reserva de carril.
objective: Pregunta el horario de cierre entre semana, cuánto cuesta la entrada de un día, si hay clases de natación, si hace falta gorro y si se puede reservar carril.
scene_context: En la taquilla de la piscina municipal te atiende un socorrista mientras otros nadadores entran.
expected_outcome_indicator: Obtains the closing time of the facility.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon! How can I help you?
User: What time does the pool close today?
Person: The pool closes at 6 PM.
User: Thank you!
Person: You're welcome. Have a nice day!

title: Pedir información sobre una clase de yoga
description: Nunca has hecho yoga y quieres probar una clase. Pregunta horarios y precio, avisa de que eres principiante y aclara prueba, esterilla y pago.
objective: Pregunta los horarios y el precio al mes, explica que eres principiante, pregunta si hay clase de prueba, si necesitas esterilla y cómo se paga.
scene_context: En una academia de yoga con velas y música suave, la profesora apunta nombres en una libreta.
expected_outcome_indicator: Finds out class location, day, and time.
example_conversation:
Person: Hi! Are you interested in our yoga class?
User: Yes. Where is the class?
Person: It's in Studio B, upstairs.
User: What day? What time?
Person: It's on Thursday at 7 PM.
User: Perfect, thank you!

title: Comprar un billete de cine
description: Es noche de cine y hay cola en la taquilla. Compra una entrada para la sesión de las ocho y pregunta si quedan asientos libres cerca.
objective: Compra en taquilla una entrada de cine para la sesión de las ocho y pregunta si quedan asientos libres cerca de la pantalla.
scene_context: Estás en la taquilla de un cine. Hablas con el vendedor de entradas.
expected_outcome_indicator: Purchases a cinema ticket with specific time.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! What can I get for you?
User: One ticket for 'Frozen 2' at 4 PM, please.
Person: That's £9.50.
User: Okay. Here is my money.
Person: Thank you! Enjoy the film!

title: Reservar un vuelo
description: Llamada internacional para cerrar un vuelo a Madrid el 15 de marzo. Quieres viajar solo, con asiento de ventana y el equipaje claro.
objective: Reserva un vuelo a Madrid para el 15 de marzo: confirma que viajas solo, elige un asiento de ventana, paga con tarjeta y pregunta qué equipaje va incluido.
scene_context: Estás llamando a una aerolínea internacional con la tarjeta en la mano. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Confirmar destino y fecha (Madrid, 15 de marzo). 2. Confirmar pasajero (solo). 3. Elegir asiento (ventana). 4. Pagar y preguntar por el equipaje.
example_conversation:
User: Hi, I'd like to book a flight to Madrid for March 15th.
Agent: Sure, I can help with that. Are you traveling alone?
User: Yes, just me.
Agent: Great. Do you have a seating preference?
User: I'd prefer a window seat, please.

title: Llamar al médico
description: No te encuentras bien y necesitas cita cuanto antes. Al otro lado del teléfono, la recepcionista del Dr. Rivera atiende con calma.
objective: Llama al consultorio del Dr. Rivera, pide una cita para mañana y explica que tienes fiebre y dolor de garganta desde anoche.
scene_context: Llamas al consultorio del Dr. Rivera; la recepcionista contesta con amabilidad. Tienes que completar 3 pasos: 1. Pedir cita para mañana. 2. Describir los síntomas (fiebre y dolor de garganta). 3. Confirmar la hora.
example_conversation:
Receptionist: Dr. Rivera's office, how can I help you?
User: Hi, I need to make an appointment for tomorrow, please.
Receptionist: Is it for a check-up or are you feeling ill?
User: I'm not feeling well. I have a fever and a sore throat.
Receptionist: Okay, we can squeeze you in at 10 AM.

title: Ordenar en un restaurante
description: Comida en un restaurante casual, pero tienes una alergia grave a los frutos secos. Pide el plato del día preguntando antes por las nueces.
objective: Ordena el plato del día, pregunta al camarero si contiene nueces por tu alergia y, si las lleva, pide una alternativa sin salsa.
scene_context: Estás en un restaurante casual; el mesero se acerca con la carta y te pregunta qué vas a ordenar. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Pedir el plato del día. 2. Preguntar por las nueces (eres alérgico). 3. Pedir una alternativa si las lleva. 4. Añadir la bebida.
example_conversation:
Waiter: Are you ready to order?
User: Yes, I'd like the daily special, please.
Waiter: Excellent choice.
User: Does it contain any nuts? I have a severe allergy.
Waiter: The sauce has crushed walnuts. I can have the chef prepare it without the sauce for you.

title: Pedir información de un curso
description: Quieres matricularte en un curso de inglés avanzado y llamas al instituto. Compara precio, fecha de inicio y descuentos antes de decidir.
objective: Pregunta cuánto cuesta el curso de inglés avanzado, cuándo empieza el próximo grupo y si hay descuento por pagar completo; pide que te reserven plaza.
scene_context: Llamas a un instituto de idiomas; la secretaria contesta con un saludo y ofrece su ayuda. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Preguntar el precio. 2. Preguntar la fecha del próximo grupo. 3. Preguntar por el descuento. 4. Pedir que te reserven plaza.
expected_outcome_indicator: Price, start date, and discount info obtained
example_conversation:
Secretary: Hello, Language Institute.
User: Hi, I'd like information about the advanced English course.
Secretary: Certainly. What would you like to know?
User: How much does it cost and when does the next group start?
Secretary: It's $200 and starts next Monday.
User: Is there a discount for paying in full?

title: Hablar de planes de fin de semana
description: Estás tomando un café con un amigo y quieres proponerle un plan. Invítale al cine del sábado con una película y una hora concretas.
objective: Invita a tu amigo a ir al cine el sábado, propón ver la nueva película de acción a las 7 PM y confirma que le apetece el plan.
scene_context: Estás en una cafetería tranquila con tu amigo, que acaba de preguntarte qué harás el fin de semana. Tienes que completar 2 pasos: 1. Proponer el plan (cine, sábado). 2. Acordar la película y la hora (acción, 7 PM).
expected_outcome_indicator: Movie plan proposed for Saturday evening
example_conversation:
Friend: Hey, any plans for the weekend?
User: I was thinking of going to the movies on Saturday. Want to come?
Friend: Sounds fun. What time?
User: The new action movie is playing at 7 PM.

title: Cambiar un artículo en una tienda
description: La camiseta que compraste la semana pasada no te queda. Vuelve a la tienda con el recibo y consigue la talla correcta.
objective: Explica en la tienda que la camiseta talla M no te queda bien, da los datos de la compra con el recibo y pide cambiarla por una talla L.
scene_context: Estás en la tienda de ropa donde compraste la camiseta, con el recibo en la mano. Tienes que completar 3 pasos: 1. Explicar el problema (talla M, no te queda). 2. Dar los datos de la compra (€19.99, hace una semana). 3. Pedir la talla L.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully explain the problem and request an exchange for a different size.
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning, how can I help you today?
User: Hi, I bought this shirt last week. It is size M but it is too small.
Person: I see, do you want to exchange it? What size do you need?
User: Yes, please. I need a size L. The price was nineteen euros and ninety-nine cents.
Person: No problem, let me check if we have it in stock.
User: Thank you very much. This size fits me much better.

title: Preguntar sobre un servicio en una peluquería
description: Quieres cortarte el pelo y llamas a la peluquería. Pregunta precio, duración y si hay hueco el sábado por la mañana.
objective: Pregunta al peluquero cuánto cuesta el corte y cuánto dura, y pide cita para el sábado a las diez de la mañana si hay hueco.
scene_context: Llamas al negocio del peluquero, que atiende entre tijeras. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Preguntar el precio (unos €25-30). 2. Preguntar la duración (unos 30 minutos). 3. Pedir hueco el sábado a las 10:00. 4. Confirmar la cita.
expected_outcome_indicator: Obtain pricing, duration, and availability information for a haircut appointment.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello, welcome to our salon. What can I do for you?
User: Hi, I want to cut my hair. How much does a haircut cost?
Person: A basic haircut is twenty-five euros. How long is your hair?
User: It is medium length. How long does the haircut take?
Person: It takes about thirty minutes. Do you want to book an appointment?
User: Yes, do you have time next Saturday at ten o'clock?

title: Comprar entradas para un evento
description: Hay concierto el 15 de marzo y no quieres quedarte sin entradas. Compra dos, compara filas y paga en taquilla.
objective: Compra dos entradas para el concierto de The Singers el 15 de marzo: confirma el precio por entrada, elige la fila y paga.
scene_context: Hablas con el vendedor en la taquilla del teatro. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Pedir dos entradas para el 15 de marzo. 2. Decir la fila preferida (primera o segunda). 3. Confirmar el precio (€35 cada una). 4. Pagar.
expected_outcome_indicator: Purchase concert tickets with specific date, quantity, and seating preference.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon! What tickets would you like today?
User: I want two tickets for The Singers concert on the fifteenth of March.
Person: Great! That concert is thirty-five euros per ticket. Where would you like to sit?
User: I prefer the first row, please. That is seventy euros in total.
Person: Perfect! Here are your tickets. Enjoy the concert!
User: Thank you very much. What time does it start?

title: Cambiar la hora de una cita médica
description: Una cita médica se te cruza con el trabajo y necesitas moverla. Propón otra hora o cambia de día sin perderla.
objective: Explica en la clínica que no puedes ir a la cita de mañana a las 14:00 y pide cambiarla a las 16:00 o a otro día de la semana.
scene_context: Llamas a la clínica del doctor para cambiar tu cita. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Identificarte. 2. Explicar el problema con la cita (mañana, 14:00). 3. Proponer alternativa (16:00 u otro día). 4. Confirmar la nueva hora.
expected_outcome_indicator: Reschedule a doctor appointment to a different time.
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning, this is the medical clinic. How can I help?
User: Hello, I have an appointment tomorrow at two o'clock, but I cannot come.
Person: I understand. What time would you prefer?
User: Can I come at four o'clock instead? Or maybe another day?
Person: Let me check. Yes, we have four o'clock available tomorrow.
User: That is perfect for me. Thank you very much!

title: Comprar un regalo de cumpleaños
description: Buscas un regalo de cumpleaños en una tienda de ropa. Encuentra el suéter azul, ajusta el presupuesto y pide envoltorio.
objective: Pregunta por un suéter azul y su precio en la tienda, pide el descuento o el envoltorio de regalo y confirma que te lo llevas.
scene_context: Estás en una tienda de ropa; un vendedor te ayuda a buscar un regalo. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Pedir un suéter azul. 2. Preguntar el precio (entre 30 y 50 euros). 3. Preguntar por el descuento o el envoltorio. 4. Confirmar la compra.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successful purchase of a gift with price confirmation and delivery/wrapping details.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! What are you looking for today?
User: Hi, I need a blue sweater for my friend's birthday next Saturday.
Person: Great! We have nice blue sweaters. What size does your friend wear?
User: Medium size, please. How much does it cost?
Person: This one is 45 euros. We offer free gift wrapping today.
User: Perfect! I'll take it. Can you wrap it for me?

title: Cambiar dinero en una oficina de cambio
description: Necesitas euros para tu viaje y llevas 200 libras encima. Compara el tipo de cambio y la comisión antes de aceptar.
objective: Pide cambiar 200 libras y pregunta el tipo de cambio, la comisión y cuántos euros vas a recibir antes de entregar el dinero.
scene_context: Estás en una oficina de cambio en el centro; un empleado te atiende tras el cristal. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Pedir el cambio de 200 libras. 2. Preguntar el tipo de cambio. 3. Preguntar la comisión. 4. Confirmar cuántos euros recibirás.
expected_outcome_indicator: Exchange transaction completed with rate and fee details confirmed.
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning! How can I help you?
User: Hello, I want to exchange 200 British pounds to euros.
Person: Okay, let me check the rate. Today it is 1.17 euros per pound.
User: So how many euros will I get?
Person: You will receive 234 euros. We charge 2 euros commission.
User: That's fine. I need the money today for my trip to Barcelona.

title: Pedir un día libre en el trabajo
description: Tienes una cita médica el miércoles por la mañana y necesitas el día libre. Habla con tu jefe y ofrece recuperar las horas.
objective: Explica a tu jefe que necesitas libre el miércoles 15 por una cita médica por la mañana, ofrece recuperar las horas y pide que lo apruebe.
scene_context: Estás en la oficina con tu jefe, que tiene un momento para hablar contigo. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Explicar el motivo (cita médica). 2. Pedir el día (miércoles 15). 3. Ofrecer recuperar el trabajo. 4. Agradecer y confirmar.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully requested day off with date and reason provided.
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning! Do you need something?
User: Yes, I have an important appointment. Can I have Wednesday, March 15 off?
Person: What is the appointment for?
User: It's a medical appointment. I need to go in the morning.
Person: Is it urgent?
User: Yes, it is very important for me. Can you approve it?

title: Alquilar una bicicleta para el fin de semana
description: Quieres alquilar una bici el sábado para moverte por la ciudad. Aclara precio, extras y la hora de recogida.
objective: Alquila una bicicleta para el sábado, pregunta el precio por día y si incluye casco y candado, y confirma que la recoges a las 10:00.
scene_context: Estás en una tienda de alquiler de bicicletas; el empleado ajusta una rueda. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Pedir la bici para el sábado. 2. Preguntar el precio (15 euros). 3. Añadir casco o candado si hace falta. 4. Confirmar la recogida a las 10:00.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully rents a bicycle for Saturday at 10 AM for €15.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! Can I help you today?
User: Yes, I want to rent a bicycle for Saturday, please.
Person: Sure! We have many bikes. How long do you need it?
User: Just for one day. What is the price?
Person: It costs fifteen euros per day. What time do you want to pick it up?
User: I can come at ten o'clock in the morning. That's good for me.

title: Comprar un teléfono móvil usado
description: En la tienda hay un móvil de segunda mano que te interesa. Comprueba su estado y su garantía antes de cerrar el precio.
objective: Pregunta el precio del iPhone 12 del escaparate, el año de fabricación y la garantía, y ciérralo por 250 euros si todo está bien.
scene_context: Estás en una tienda pequeña de electrónica usada; el vendedor te enseña un teléfono del escaparate. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Preguntar el precio. 2. Preguntar el año de fabricación. 3. Preguntar la garantía (6 meses). 4. Cerrar la compra por 250 euros.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student successfully negotiates phone purchase with price, warranty details.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! Can I help you today?
User: Yes, how much is this iPhone 12 in the window?
Person: It costs 280 euros. It's in very good condition.
User: Does it have a warranty? I want six months warranty.
Person: We offer six months warranty on all used phones. I can give you 250 euros today.
User: Perfect! I'll take it. Can you wrap it for me?

title: Reservar una clase de arte en un centro comunitario
description: Quieres empezar pintura los martes por la tarde. Pregunta horario, precio y materiales antes de reservar tu plaza.
objective: Pregunta por la clase de pintura de los martes a las 19:00, el precio al mes y si incluye los materiales, y reserva tu sitio.
scene_context: Estás llamando al centro comunitario; la recepcionista te cuenta las clases disponibles. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Preguntar por la clase de los martes a las 19:00. 2. Preguntar el precio (45 euros al mes). 3. Preguntar por los materiales. 4. Reservar tu sitio.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student books art class with correct day, time, and price confirmed.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon! Community Centre. How can I help?
User: Hi. Do you have painting classes on Tuesdays?
Person: Yes, we have a class at 7 PM. Are you interested?
User: Yes! What is the price per month?
Person: It's 45 euros, and all materials are included.
User: Great! Can I book a place for next month?

title: Problema técnico al soporte
description: Tu computador no enciende desde esta mañana y tienes trabajo acumulado. Llamas al soporte técnico y describes el fallo paso a paso.
objective: Explica al agente de soporte que tu computador no enciende desde esta mañana, describe el ruido extraño que escuchas al pulsar el botón y confirma que estás en tu escritorio.
scene_context: Llamas al soporte técnico de tu empresa; el agente contesta y pide que describas el problema. Tienes que completar 2 pasos: 1. Explicar el fallo (no enciende desde esta mañana). 2. Describir el sonido extraño al encenderlo y confirmar que estás listo.
expected_outcome_indicator: Support ticket opened with correct details
example_conversation:
User: Hello, I'm calling because my computer won't turn on.
Agent: I'm sorry to hear that. Did anything happen before this?
User: It was working fine yesterday, but this morning I heard a strange noise and it won't start.
Agent: Okay, let's try some troubleshooting steps.

title: Check-in en el hotel
description: Después de un viaje largo llegas al Hotel Plaza y tu reserva no aparece. Toca explicarlo en recepción con el número de confirmación.
objective: Explica al recepcionista que tu reserva de esta noche no aparece en la app, facilita el número de confirmación #45823 y confirma tu nombre.
scene_context: Llegas al Hotel Plaza después de un viaje largo; el recepcionista te saluda y pide tu nombre. Tienes que completar 2 pasos: 1. Explicar el problema con la reserva (no aparece en la app). 2. Dar el número de confirmación (#45823) y confirmar tu nombre.
example_conversation:
Receptionist: Good afternoon, welcome to Hotel Plaza. Do you have a reservation?
User: Yes, I booked a room for tonight, but I don't see it on my app.
Receptionist: Let me check. Do you have the confirmation number?
User: Yes, it's #45823. I booked it last week.
Receptionist: Ah, found it. There was a typo in the name. You're all set.

title: Presentarse en trabajo nuevo
description: Es tu primer día en la empresa y tu colega se acerca a saludar. Preséntate con tu cargo y cuenta tu experiencia anterior.
objective: Preséntate a tu nuevo colega con tu nombre y tu cargo de Marketing Manager, y cuéntale tu experiencia anterior en publicidad digital.
scene_context: Entras a la oficina el primer día; tu colega se acerca sonriendo y se presenta. Tienes que completar 2 pasos: 1. Dar tu nombre y tu cargo (Marketing Manager). 2. Mencionar tu experiencia anterior (cinco años en publicidad digital).
example_conversation:
Colleague: Hi, welcome to the team! I'm Sarah.
User: Hi Sarah, nice to meet you. I'm Alex.
Colleague: What will you be working on?
User: I'm the new Marketing Manager. I used to work in digital advertising for 5 years.

title: Reportar un problema de vecindad
description: El apartamento 4B pone música a todo volumen cada noche y ya no puedes dormir. Llamas al administrador para que intervenga.
objective: Reporta al administrador que el apartamento 4B pone música muy alta desde las 11 p. m. todos los días, aclara que no has hablado con ellos y pide que la administración intervenga.
scene_context: Llamas a la oficina de administración del edificio; el administrador contesta y abre una incidencia. Tienes que completar 3 pasos: 1. Describir el problema (apartamento 4B, música alta, desde las 11 p. m.). 2. Aclarar que no has hablado con ellos. 3. Pedir que la administración intervenga.
example_conversation:
User: Hello, I'm calling to report a noise problem.
Manager: Okay, what seems to be the issue?
User: Apartment 4B has been playing very loud music every night since 11 PM.
Manager: I see. Have you spoken to them?
User: No, I'd like you to intervene, please.

title: Conversación casual en una boda
description: Estás en una boda sentado con desconocidos y la cena no empieza. Rompe el hielo con la persona de al lado y comentad la ceremonia.
objective: Inicia una conversación con la persona de al lado en la mesa: pregunta cómo conoce a los novios y comenta qué te ha parecido la ceremonia.
scene_context: Estás en la recepción de una boda elegante; la cena aún no empieza y hay un silencio incómodo en la mesa. Tienes que completar 2 pasos: 1. Preguntar cómo conoce a los novios. 2. Comentar qué te parece la ceremonia.
expected_outcome_indicator: Conversation started about the couple and ceremony
example_conversation:
User: It's a beautiful ceremony, isn't it?
Guest: Yes, absolutely lovely. Are you a friend of the bride or groom?
User: I'm a friend of the groom from high school. And you?

title: Recomendar un restaurante
description: Un colega de otra sucursal quiere cenar bien en tu ciudad. Recomiéndale tu italiano favorito y explícale cómo llegar desde la oficina.
objective: Recomienda a tu colega el restaurante italiano La Trattoria, explica por qué es bueno (comida y ambiente) e indica cómo llegar desde la oficina.
scene_context: Estás en el descanso del café con un colega de otra sucursal que quiere probar comida local esta noche. Tienes que completar 2 pasos: 1. Recomendar el restaurante y justificarlo (comida y ambiente). 2. Explicar cómo llegar desde la oficina.
expected_outcome_indicator: Restaurant recommendation given with reasons and directions
example_conversation:
Colleague: I'm looking for a good place for dinner tonight. Do you know any local spots?
User: You have to try 'La Trattoria'. It's my favorite Italian place.
Colleague: Oh, that sounds good. Why do you like it?
User: The pasta is handmade and the atmosphere is very cozy. plus, it's just two blocks from here.

title: Reclamar una devolución de ropa defectuosa
description: Compraste un abrigo hace dos semanas y la cremallera ya está rota. Vuelves a la tienda con el recibo y buscas el reembolso completo.
objective: Devuelve el abrigo azul marino (€89,99, comprado hace 14 días): explica que la cremallera está rota, pide el reembolso completo en vez de un cambio y pregunta cuánto tarda (3-5 días hábiles).
scene_context: Estás en el mostrador de atención al cliente de una tienda de moda con el abrigo y el recibo. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Explicar la compra (abrigo, €89,99, 14 días). 2. Explicar el defecto (cremallera rota). 3. Pedir el reembolso completo y rebatir el cambio. 4. Preguntar el plazo (3-5 días hábiles).
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully explained product defect, negotiated refund instead of exchange, and received information about refund timeline.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon, how can I help you today?
User: Hi, I bought this navy blue coat here two weeks ago for €89.99, but the zipper is completely broken. I'd like a full refund rather than an exchange because I don't trust the quality.
Person: I understand your frustration. May I see the receipt and the coat? Unfortunately, our policy states we offer exchanges first, but if you'd prefer a refund, I could process that today.
User: Yes, I would really appreciate a refund. How long would it take to receive the money back to my card?
Person: Typically it takes between three and five business days once I process it. Would you like me to proceed with that?
User: Yes, please. Could you also explain why the zipper failed so quickly? I'm concerned about the overall durability of your products.
Person: That's a fair question. We'll look into this batch. Your refund will be processed immediately, and you should see it within five days maximum.

title: Posponer una entrevista de trabajo importante
description: Tu entrevista del 15 de marzo choca con una cita médica que no puedes cancelar. Llama a la reclutadora para posponerla sin perder el puesto.
objective: Llama al reclutador: explica la cita médica, pide posponer la entrevista dos semanas (del 15 al 29 de marzo), discúlpate por el aviso tardío y confirma que sigues interesado.
scene_context: Llamas por teléfono a recursos humanos de una empresa tecnológica; hablas con Paula, la reclutadora. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Explicar la cita médica. 2. Pedir posponer del 15 al 29 de marzo. 3. Disculparte por el aviso tardío. 4. Confirmar que sigues interesado.
expected_outcome_indicator: Secured postponement of interview by two weeks while maintaining professional tone and expressing continued interest.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello, this is Paula from HR. I see you're calling about your interview appointment.
User: Hi Paula, yes, I'm calling because I need to reschedule my interview scheduled for March 15th. I have a medical appointment that was booked a month ago and I can't cancel it.
Person: I see. That's quite short notice. Can you tell me more about why you can't move your medical appointment instead?
User: Unfortunately, it's a specialist appointment that took weeks to get, so rescheduling would be very difficult. Could I possibly postpone the interview to March 29th instead?
Person: Let me check our calendar... Actually, March 29th works. However, I do need to ask: are you still genuinely interested in this position despite these complications?
User: Absolutely, I'm very interested. I apologize for the inconvenience, and I promise you won't regret reconsidering my application. Thank you so much for your flexibility.

title: Negociar el contrato de un Airbnb antes de reservar
description: Antes de reservar el Airbnb de Gràcia quieres negociar. Pide descuento por estancia larga y aclara la política de cancelación.
objective: Negocia la reserva del 10 al 17 de abril (7 noches): pide un 15% de descuento por estancia larga, pregunta la política de cancelación y cierra el precio de €700 a €595.
scene_context: Envías un mensaje al propietario de un apartamento de dos dormitorios en Gràcia, Barcelona. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Plantear las fechas (10-17 de abril, 7 noches). 2. Pedir el 15% de descuento (de €700 a €595). 3. Preguntar la política de cancelación. 4. Confirmar condiciones y reserva.
expected_outcome_indicator: Negotiated a 15% discount for week-long stay and clarified inclusion of utilities and cancellation terms.
example_conversation:
Person: Hello! Thanks for your interest in my apartment. When are you planning to stay?
User: Hi! I'm interested in booking from April 10th to 17th—that's seven nights. I noticed your rate is €100 per night, so that would be €700 total. Since it's a longer stay, would you consider offering a discount, perhaps 15%?
Person: I appreciate the inquiry, but my prices are quite reasonable for the neighborhood. What if I offered 10% instead, bringing it to €630?
User: I understand, but I've seen similar places offering better rates for week-long bookings. Could we meet at 12% for around €615? Also, I'd like to confirm—does that price include WiFi, heating, and the initial cleaning?
Person: The WiFi and heating are included, yes. Initial cleaning is separate at €50. So with 12% discount plus cleaning, it would be €680 total. What about your cancellation policy requirements?
User: That works better. For cancellation, I'd prefer flexible cancellation up to five days before arrival. Is that possible with your terms?
Person: My standard policy is moderate, which allows cancellation up to 7 days before. I could adjust to 5 days for you given the longer stay. Shall I send you the official listing link to confirm the booking?

title: Argumentar la necesidad de trabajar desde casa
description: Tras seis meses en la empresa quieres teletrabajar lunes y miércoles. Prepara tus argumentos y propón una prueba a tu jefa.
objective: Solicita teletrabajar lunes y miércoles: da tres razones (menos distracciones, mejor concentración, dos horas menos de transporte), ofrece un mes de prueba y propone reuniones presenciales los martes y jueves.
scene_context: Tienes una reunión en el despacho de María, directora de marketing. Tienes que completar 5 pasos: 1. Proponer el teletrabajo (lunes y miércoles). 2. Dar tres razones con datos. 3. Ofrecer un mes de prueba. 4. Proponer reuniones presenciales (martes y jueves). 5. Aceptar cómo se medirá el resultado.
expected_outcome_indicator: Presented structured proposal for remote work with clear benefits and willingness to trial the arrangement.
example_conversation:
Person: Come in, sit down. What did you want to discuss with me today?
User: Thank you for making time. I wanted to propose a flexible work arrangement. After six months here, I've noticed I'm most productive when I can concentrate deeply on big projects without office distractions. I'd like to work from home on Mondays and Wednesdays.
Person: Interesting idea, but our team usually collaborates daily. What specific benefits do you see for the company, not just for yourself?
User: Good question. I'd be more focused for detailed work, which means fewer errors and faster deliveries. I'd also save two hours commuting, which I could reinvest in my projects. I'm happy to come in Tuesday through Thursday for all meetings and collaborative work.
Person: That sounds reasonable, but I'm hesitant about the precedent this sets. What if other team members demand the same?
User: I completely understand your concern. What if we trial this for one month and measure my output and team communication? If it works well, we can discuss it with the team. If it doesn't, we revert to the current arrangement.
Person: That's a fair proposal. Let's try it for December and revisit in January. I'll need you to send me a detailed schedule showing your collaboration hours.

title: Cambiar el horario de una clase que ya pagaste
description: Una reunión de trabajo te impide ir a tu clase de pilates del jueves. Llama al gimnasio para cambiar el horario de una clase ya pagada.
objective: Llama al gimnasio para cambiar tu clase de pilates del jueves a las 18:30 (pagaste €80 hace un mes), explica la reunión de trabajo y pregunta si hay coste adicional.
scene_context: Llamas por teléfono al centro FitLife; te atiende recepción. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Identificarte y dar la clase (pilates, jueves 18:30, €80 pagados). 2. Explicar la reunión de trabajo. 3. Pedir otro horario disponible. 4. Preguntar si hay coste adicional.
expected_outcome_indicator: Rescheduled pilates class with work conflict explanation and confirmed no additional fee.
example_conversation:
Person: FitLife Gym, how can I assist you?
User: Hi, I need to reschedule my Thursday pilates class at 6:30 PM. I have an unexpected work meeting that day and can't attend.
Person: I understand. Let me check our schedule. Do you remember which instructor you had?
User: Yes, it was Maria's class. I paid 80 euros a month ago and I'd like to move it to another time. Is there an extra charge?
Person: No extra charge at all. Maria teaches Tuesday and Saturday mornings as well. Would either of those work for you?
User: Tuesday morning would be perfect. Could you confirm the new booking and let me know if I need to do anything else?

title: Reclamar un vuelo retrasado y pedir compensación
description: Tu vuelo BA 302 se retrasó cuatro horas y no recibiste las comidas. Reclama en el mostrador los 250 euros que te corresponden.
objective: Habla con Blue Airways: reclama por el retraso de 4 horas del vuelo BA 302 del 15 de marzo, menciona las comidas solicitadas y no recibidas, y pregunta si eres elegible para los €250 de indemnización.
scene_context: Estás en el mostrador de atención al cliente del aeropuerto, recién bajado del avión. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Dar la referencia (BA 302, 15 de marzo). 2. Explicar el retraso de 4 horas. 3. Mencionar las comidas no recibidas. 4. Preguntar por la indemnización de €250.
expected_outcome_indicator: Registered flight delay complaint with meal refund and compensation eligibility explained.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon. I see you're here about a delayed flight. Can I have your booking reference?
User: Yes, it's BA 302 from March 15th. The flight was delayed four hours, and I requested meals during the wait but never received them. What compensation am I entitled to?
Person: I'm very sorry about that experience. According to EU regulations, you're eligible for 250 euros because the delay exceeded three hours. Did you purchase anything yourself?
User: Yes, I bought a sandwich and coffee for about 15 euros. Will that be refunded as well?
Person: Of course. I'll process both the compensation and your meal expenses. You should receive everything within two to three weeks to your bank account.
User: Thank you. Can you email me confirmation of this claim so I have it documented?

title: Reclamar sobre un electrodoméstico defectuoso
description: El microondas que compraste hace dos semanas no calienta bien. En el mostrador negocias entre reparación gratuita y reembolso.
objective: Explica que el microondas no calienta bien (comprado hace 14 días por €89), negocia entre reparación gratuita y reembolso completo, y justifica tu elección.
scene_context: Estás en el mostrador de atención al cliente de una tienda de electrodomésticos con el microondas y el recibo. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Explicar la compra (14 días, €89). 2. Explicar el defecto (no calienta bien). 3. Escuchar las opciones (reparación o reembolso). 4. Negociar y justificar tu elección.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully negotiate repair or refund for faulty microwave bought 2 weeks ago for €89.
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning, I see you'd like to speak to me about a microwave. What seems to be the problem?
User: Yes, I bought this microwave fourteen days ago for eighty-nine euros, but it doesn't heat food properly anymore. I've tried it several times and nothing works.
Person: I understand your frustration. Do you have the receipt with you? We could either repair it free of charge or process a refund, though that might take up to two weeks.
User: I have the receipt here. Honestly, I'd prefer a refund because I need a working microwave right now for my daily cooking. Would that be possible?
Person: Since you're within our two-week return window, I can absolutely arrange that for you. Can I have your name and contact details?
User: Of course. It's Elena Martínez, and my email is elena.martinez@email.com. When would the refund appear in my bank account?
Person: It should process within five to seven business days. I'll email you a confirmation receipt today.

title: Reclamar un reembolso parcial por un viaje pospuesto
description: Tuviste que posponer el viaje a Barcelona del 15 de julio al 20 de septiembre. Negocia con la agencia cuánto dinero recuperas.
objective: Consigue un reembolso de al menos €200 de los €850 del viaje a Barcelona pospuesto del 15 de julio al 20 de septiembre: explica los motivos, pregunta por la política de cancelación y negocia las condiciones.
scene_context: Estás en la oficina de Viajes Express, frente a María, la agente que organizó tu reserva. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Explicar la reserva original (€850, 15 de julio). 2. Explicar el motivo del cambio (20 de septiembre). 3. Preguntar la política de cancelación. 4. Negociar un reembolso de al menos €200.
expected_outcome_indicator: Student negotiates partial refund for postponed trip and clarifies cancellation policy.
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning! I'm here about my Barcelona trip booking. How can I help you today?
User: Hello Maria. I booked a trip for July 15th for 850 euros, but I need to postpone it until September 20th due to personal reasons. Is it possible to get a refund?
Person: I understand. Let me check the cancellation policy. Since you're postponing rather than cancelling completely, we typically charge a 30% administration fee. That would be about 255 euros in fees.
User: That seems quite high. I'm still travelling with you, just at a different date. Could you consider a lower fee, maybe 15%? What if I book additional services?
Person: I appreciate your loyalty. A 15% fee would be 127 euros, leaving you with a credit of 723 euros. However, the September date has different pricing, so you may need to pay a small difference.
User: That sounds more reasonable. Can you check if the September dates are available and tell me what the price difference would be? Also, can I get a written confirmation of this agreement?

title: Reclamar sobre un mal servicio de limpieza del hogar
description: La limpieza de la semana pasada dejó la cocina y los baños a medias. Reclama a la empresa una repetición sin coste y una fecha.
objective: Explica qué salió mal en la limpieza (cocina, baños y alfombras), pregunta si pueden volver sin coste adicional y acuerda una fecha entre el 15 y el 20 de marzo.
scene_context: Llamas a la empresa de limpieza; te atiende el gerente de servicio al cliente. Tienes que completar 4 pasos: 1. Explicar qué salió mal (cocina, baños, alfombras). 2. Explicar por qué no estás satisfecho. 3. Pedir una repetición sin coste. 4. Acordar fecha entre el 15 y el 20 de marzo.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully complains about service quality, provides specific details, and negotiates a free revisit.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon, thank you for calling CleanHome Services. How can I help you today?
User: Hello, I'm calling because I'm really disappointed with the cleaning service you provided at my house last week. The kitchen wasn't thoroughly cleaned and the bathrooms still had stains.
Person: I'm very sorry to hear that. Could you tell me more about what exactly didn't meet your expectations? We pride ourselves on our quality standards.
User: Well, the tiles in both bathrooms weren't properly scrubbed, the kitchen appliances were left streaky, and the carpets looked like they hadn't been vacuumed properly. I've been a customer for two years and this is the worst job they've done.
Person: That's concerning. I sincerely apologize. Would you be willing to let us send a team to redo the cleaning at no additional charge?
User: Yes, that would be great. Could we schedule it between March 15th and 20th? Would morning or afternoon be better for you?
Person: We can definitely arrange that. How about March 18th in the morning, around 9 AM?
User: That works perfectly. Thank you for resolving this so quickly.

title: Negociar un precio
description: Estás en un mercado artesanal y ves una mochila de cuero que te encanta. El vendedor pide $80 y tú quieres regatear sin ofender.
objective: Negocia el precio de una mochila de cuero que cuesta 80 dólares: ofrece argumentos de calidad y de mercado, y cierra la compra por menos de 65.
scene_context: Estás en un mercado artesanal. El vendedor tiene mochilas de cuero. Ves una que te gusta.
example_conversation:
User: I love this backpack, but $80 is a bit out of my budget.
Vendor: It's good quality leather. How much were you thinking?
User: Could you do $60? I'm buying it as a gift.
Vendor: I can't go that low, but I could do $70.
User: How about $65? That matches the cash I have.

title: Reclamar un paquete perdido
description: Tu pedido online debía llegar hace cinco días y sigues sin noticias. Llamas a la empresa de envíos con el número de seguimiento a mano.
objective: Reclama a la empresa de envíos que tu paquete con seguimiento TK-2847 no llegó en la fecha prometida, explica los cinco días de espera y pide una solución concreta antes de colgar.
scene_context: Llamas al servicio al cliente de la empresa de envíos. Llevas 5 días esperando el paquete.
example_conversation:
Agent: Customer service, how can I help?
User: Hi, I'm calling about a missing package. Tracking number TK-2847.
Agent: Let me check. It says it was delivered yesterday.
User: I've been home all day and nothing arrived. I need a solution or a refund.

title: Cancelar una suscripción
description: Llevas seis meses pagando el gimnasio sin pisarlo y no quieres pagar un mes más. Llamas para cancelar la suscripción con tiempo.
objective: Cancela tu suscripción al gimnasio tras seis meses sin ir, pide que no te cobren el próximo mes y pide confirmación por escrito del cierre.
scene_context: Llamas al servicio al cliente del gimnasio. Te contesta un representante.
example_conversation:
Agent: Gym membership services, how can I help?
User: Hi, I'd like to cancel my subscription.
Agent: May I ask why you're leaving?
User: I haven't used it in 6 months. Please ensure no charge is made next month.
Agent: I can process that for you.

title: Describir un accidente menor
description: Un coche te golpeó por detrás mientras esperabas en un semáforo y no hay heridos. Un oficial se acerca para tomar tu declaración.
objective: Explica al oficial que otro coche te golpeó por detrás mientras esperabas en un semáforo, describe los daños y aclara que no hay heridos.
scene_context: Un oficial de policía se acerca al lugar del accidente y pide tu declaración de lo sucedido.
expected_outcome_indicator: Accident description given with key details
example_conversation:
Officer: Can you tell me what happened here?
User: Yes, officer. I was waiting at the red light.
Officer: And then?
User: Another car hit me from behind. There are no injuries, just damage to the bumper.

title: Debatir sobre una película
description: Acabas de salir del cine con un amigo que salió encantado. A ti el final no te convenció y toca explicarlo sin desanimar la charla.
objective: Expón con respeto que el final te pareció decepcionante porque no tuvo sentido, reconoce los buenos efectos especiales y debate las razones con tu amigo.
scene_context: Están saliendo del cine. Tu amigo dice que le encantó la película y te pregunta qué piensas tú.
expected_outcome_indicator: Opinion expressed with pros and cons
example_conversation:
Friend: That was amazing! The best movie I've seen all year. What did you think?
User: To be honest, I was a bit disappointed.
Friend: Really? Why?
User: The special effects were great, but the ending didn't make any sense to me.

title: Resolver una factura telefónica con cargos duplicados
description: Tu factura móvil de €87,50 trae dos cargos de roaming repetidos del 12 de junio. Llamas a la operadora para disputarlos y pedir compensación.
objective: Debes identificar los cargos duplicados en tu factura de €87,50 (dos cargos de roaming internacional de €35 del 12 de junio), solicitar un reembolso completo más una compensación por la inconveniencia, y obtener una explicación por escrito.
scene_context: Estás llamando al servicio de atención al cliente de tu operadora móvil. Un agente te atiende después de esperar 8 minutos.
expected_outcome_indicator: Duplicate charges removed, full refund obtained, compensation approved.
example_conversation:
Person: Thank you for calling. I see here you're questioning charges from June 12th. Can you walk me through your concern?
User: Yes, there are two identical roaming charges of €35 on the same date, which appears to be a system error since I only used data once that day.
Person: I understand your frustration. Let me investigate the billing records to determine what happened.
User: I'd appreciate that. Furthermore, this error has caused me considerable inconvenience, so I'll need a full reimbursement plus compensation for the trouble.
Person: We can certainly credit both charges back. As for compensation, I can offer a €15 credit to your next bill as goodwill.
User: I appreciate the gesture, but given the billing error took two weeks to discover, I'd find €25 more appropriate to acknowledge the inconvenience.
Person: That's fair. I'll process the full reimbursement of €70 plus a €25 credit immediately, and you'll receive written confirmation within 24 hours.

title: Disputar un depósito de caución en un Airbnb después del checkout
description: El anfitrión del Airbnb te reclama €200 del depósito por una mancha que ya estaba antes. Respondes con tus fotos de la llegada y exiges la devolución.
objective: El anfitrión reclama €200 del depósito de €500 por una mancha en el sofá que afirma no estaba allí antes. Debes demostrar con evidencia fotográfica de tu llegada que el daño ya existía, negarte a pagar, y exigir la devolución completa del depósito dentro de 10 días.
scene_context: Recibes un mensaje de Airbnb del anfitrión después de tu checkout el 15 de marzo. Respondes a su reclamo enviando fotos y argumentando tu posición.
expected_outcome_indicator: Full deposit refund justified with photographic evidence.
example_conversation:
Person: I'm claiming €200 because the sofa now has a stain that wasn't there before. Please accept this deduction from your security deposit.
User: I must respectfully disagree. I took photos on arrival showing the same stain was already present, which I documented in the platform's check-in report.
Person: I don't recall seeing those photos in your initial comments. Are you certain they're timestamped correctly?
User: Yes, the metadata confirms they were taken at 3:45 PM on March 1st, well before I occupied the property. I've attached them for your review.
Person: Upon reviewing your evidence, the stain does appear to have existed previously. I apologize for the confusion and will authorize full deposit return immediately.
User: Thank you for reconsidering. Please process the complete €500 reimbursement within the binding agreement's 10-day window, and I'll leave you a fair review.
Person: Done. Your refund will appear in your account by March 25th, and I appreciate your understanding.

title: Reclamar un reembolso por un vuelo modificado
description: La aerolínea reprogramó tu vuelo y te ha roto los planes de trabajo del 15 de marzo. Llamas para negociar un reembolso o un vuelo alternativo gratis.
objective: Debes negociar un reembolso parcial de 150 euros o un vuelo alternativo gratuito para el 15 de marzo a las 10:00, argumentando que los cambios en tu itinerario te han causado pérdidas económicas significativas en tus planes de trabajo.
scene_context: Estás llamando al departamento de atención al cliente de una aerolínea. Hablas con un agente que intenta resolver tu queja de manera formal.
expected_outcome_indicator: Negotiated partial refund or alternative flight with compensation
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon, I understand you're calling about your flight modification. Could you provide your booking reference, please?
User: Yes, my reference is BX4729. My flight was pushed back by eight hours without prior notice, which has created substantial inconvenience and financial loss for my business meeting.
Person: I sincerely apologize for the disruption. However, according to our terms and conditions, we're entitled to reschedule flights due to operational reasons.
User: I'm aware of those conditions, but given the significant impact this has had on my schedule, I believe you should offer either a full reimbursement or a complimentary rebooking on an earlier flight as compensation.
Person: Let me check what options are available. We might be able to offer you a travel voucher worth 100 euros instead.
User: That's insufficient given the circumstances. I'd prefer either 150 euros reimbursed to my account or a confirmed seat on the 10:00 departure on March 15th, whichever comes first.

title: Reclamar sobre una compra defectuosa con devolución rechazada
description: Tu aspirador Dyson XR7 (€280) dejó de funcionar a las cinco semanas y la tienda se niega a devolverlo por "garantía vencida".
objective: Debes argumentar que el artículo (un aspirador sin bolsa Dyson modelo XR7 comprado por 280 euros el 15 de enero) tiene un defecto de fabricación, no desgaste normal, y que dentro de 14 días deberías tener derecho a cambio o reembolso según la Directiva de Derechos del Consumidor, independientemente de lo que diga el recibo.
scene_context: Estás en la sección de servicio al cliente de una tienda de electrónica. El gerente intenta convencerte de que el producto está fuera de garantía.
expected_outcome_indicator: Defective appliance returned for replacement or refund within cooling-off period
example_conversation:
Person: I've reviewed your receipt. I'm afraid your Dyson XR7 is outside the manufacturer's one-month guarantee period. There's nothing we can do for you.
User: I respectfully disagree. The aspiration motor failed unexpectedly after only five weeks of normal use, which clearly indicates a manufacturing defect rather than normal wear and tear. This is materially different from the product I purchased.
Person: Even if it's a defect, you're well beyond our return window. Our policy states that customers have fourteen days to return items.
User: Your internal policy doesn't override consumer protection regulations. According to EU consumer law, I have fourteen days from purchase to return a defective item, which falls within my rights period.
Person: That's not quite accurate. The cooling-off period applies to online purchases primarily, not in-store transactions.
User: That's incorrect. The cooling-off period for manufacturing defects applies across all retail channels. Furthermore, I'm invoking my statutory right to a replacement or reimbursement of 280 euros because the product fails to meet the standards I reasonably expected. I'm prepared to provide photographic evidence of the malfunction.

title: Reclamar por un servicio de catering insatisfactorio
description: La comida del catering llegó fría, faltaron postres y el servicio se retrasó cuarenta minutos. Llamas al gerente para reclamar parte de los €450.
objective: Debes explicar que la comida llegó fría, que faltaban 15 porciones de postre, que el servicio fue lento (40 minutos de retraso) y que pagaste 450 euros. Exige un reembolso parcial del 30% o la devolución del dinero completo si no aceptan las condiciones.
scene_context: Estás llamando por teléfono al gerente de la empresa de catering 'Delicious Events' el día después del evento para presentar tu queja formal.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully lodge a formal complaint and negotiate compensation for poor service quality.
example_conversation:
Person: Good morning, this is James from Delicious Events speaking. How can I help you today?
User: Hello James. I'm calling to lodge a formal complaint about your catering service yesterday at my corporate event. The food arrived cold, which was completely unacceptable for a 200-person function that I paid 450 euros for.
Person: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you provide me with more details about what exactly went wrong during the service?
User: Absolutely. First, you were 40 minutes late, which threw off my entire schedule. Second, you were short 15 dessert portions, and third, the main courses were nowhere near the temperature they should have been. This was a binding agreement, and you failed to deliver the standards we discussed.
Person: I understand your frustration, and I sincerely apologize for these inconveniences. What resolution would you be looking for?
User: I'm seeking either a 30% reimbursement given the gravity of these issues, or I'll have to pursue this further. I have witnesses and photographs documenting the problems. I trust we can resolve this amicably, but I need a commitment from you today.

title: Negociar el cambio de términos en un contrato de alquiler
description: Antes de firmar el contrato de alquiler quieres renegociarlo. Te reúnes con el señor García para bajar la renta y reducir el depósito.
objective: Debes solicitar una reducción del precio de alquiler de 1200 euros a 1050 euros por mes (duración 24 meses), y además pedir que el depósito de caución se reduzca de 3 meses a 2 meses de renta. Debes presentar argumentos sobre el estado del apartamento (necesita reparaciones menores) y justificar con datos de mercado.
scene_context: Te reúnes en persona con el propietario, señor García, en la oficina de su agencia inmobiliaria para discutir los términos del contrato antes de la firma final.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully renegotiate lease terms with evidence-based arguments and reach a mutually acceptable agreement.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon. I've reviewed your application and I'm pleased you're interested in the apartment. However, I must mention the rent is non-negotiable at 1200 euros monthly. Shall we proceed to signing?
User: Thank you for considering my application, señor García. Before we sign, I'd like to discuss the terms, as I have some legitimate concerns about both the rent and the deposit structure. The market rate for similar properties in this neighborhood is approximately 1050 euros, according to three recent listings I've reviewed.
Person: I understand you've done your research, but my property includes premium finishes and a convenient location. The deposit is standard at three months' rent. What specifically are your concerns?
User: While I appreciate the location, the apartment does require some minor repairs—the bathroom tiles need grouting, and the kitchen door hinges are loose. Given these issues and current market conditions, I'm proposing 1050 euros monthly rent with a two-month deposit instead of three. This is still a fair rate for the property, and it demonstrates my commitment with a substantial deposit.
Person: Those repairs are minor cosmetic issues that won't affect your tenancy. However, I respect your position. Let me consider your proposal, as a 24-month commitment does have value for me.

title: Defender tu posición en una reunión sobre cambio de responsabilidades laborales
description: Tu gerente María quiere cargarte el marketing de formación con 15 horas extra a la semana. Ya llevas 45 horas y dos proyectos: te niegas.
objective: En una reunión con tu gerente, explicar por qué no puedes asumir las responsabilidades adicionales del proyecto de marketing (que implica 15 horas semanales extra sin compensación) cuando ya trabajas en dos proyectos simultáneamente con una carga de 45 horas, solicitando que se contrate personal adicional o se redefina tu rol con ajuste salarial del 12%.
scene_context: Estás en la oficina en una reunión con tu gerente, Maria. Ella acaba de proponerte tomar el proyecto de marketing de forma inesperada.
expected_outcome_indicator: Negotiated workload expectations and secured commitment to review compensation or staffing.
example_conversation:
Person: As you know, we've decided to merge the marketing initiative with your current responsibilities. We believe you're the best fit for this expanded role given your track record and expertise in digital communications.
User: I appreciate your confidence, Maria, but I have to be honest—this proposal isn't feasible given my current commitments. I'm already managing two concurrent projects that require 45 hours per week, and adding 15 hours of marketing work would be unsustainable without compromising quality or my wellbeing.
Person: Understood, but the project is time-sensitive, and we simply don't have budget approval for additional hiring at the moment. Could you prioritize and perhaps delegate some of your existing tasks?
User: I've already optimized my workflow considerably. What I'm proposing is either hiring a junior team member to support me, or alternatively, if the company insists on this expanded scope, we'd need to discuss a salary adjustment of at least 12% to reflect the new responsibilities and workload.
Person: That's quite a significant request. Let me discuss this with upper management and get back to you.
User: I appreciate that, Maria. However, I do need a resolution within the next two weeks, as I cannot commit to this additional workload under the current terms. I'm hoping we can find a solution that works for both the company and my career development.

title: Presentar una propuesta alternativa en una entrevista de trabajo sobre horario flexible
description: Entrevista final en Deloitte y todo va bien, pero necesitas dos días de teletrabajo. Toca defenderlo sin parecer poco comprometido.
objective: En tu entrevista final para el puesto de Analista de Datos en Deloitte (salario €48,000 anuales, contrato de 3 años), explicar por qué necesitas trabajar 2 días desde casa y 3 desde la oficina, argumentar cómo esto mejorará tu productividad y concentración, y ofrecer un acuerdo de 6 meses de prueba con métricas de desempeño claras.
scene_context: Estás en la oficina de Deloitte en una reunión con el director de recursos humanos, Thomas. Ha mencionado que la posición requiere presencia completa en la oficina 5 días a la semana.
expected_outcome_indicator: Negotiated hybrid work arrangement with performance review period.
example_conversation:
Person: We're delighted with your technical qualifications, but I should mention that this analyst role traditionally requires full-time office attendance. Our teams collaborate extensively, and we believe the best results come from in-person interaction.
User: I truly appreciate the offer, and I'm committed to delivering exceptional results for Deloitte. I'd like to propose a hybrid arrangement where I work three days in the office for team collaboration and two days remotely for focused analytical work that requires deep concentration without interruptions.
Person: That's an interesting suggestion, but it deviates significantly from our standard policy. Many clients expect our analysts to be available on-site during business hours.
User: I understand those concerns, which is why I'm proposing we implement this as a six-month trial period with clear performance metrics. I'm confident that my productivity, project completion rates, and code quality will demonstrate that this arrangement is not only feasible but actually enhances output. Should the metrics fall below agreed benchmarks, we can revert to the full on-site model.
Person: That's a thoughtful proposal. Let me discuss this with the team leads and see if we can accommodate this arrangement on a trial basis.
User: Thank you, Thomas. I believe this flexibility will allow me to contribute my best work while maintaining the collaborative spirit your team values. I'm eager to make this partnership successful.

title: Discutir una prórroga de plazo de entrega con tu profesor
description: El ensayo de fin de semestre sobre cambio climático no llegará a tiempo. Vas a ver al profesor para negociar dos semanas de prórroga.
objective: Debes convencer al profesor de que te otorgue una prórroga de 14 días para entregar tu ensayo sobre cambio climático, explicando las razones válidas (enfermedad familiar, problema técnico) y comprometiéndote a entregar un trabajo de calidad superior.
scene_context: Estás en la oficina de tu profesor de la Universidad durante sus horas de consulta. Él es un docente experimentado pero conocido por ser estricto con los plazos.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully negotiates a two-week extension with clear conditions and commitment.
example_conversation:
Person: Good afternoon. I see you've come to discuss your assignment deadline. What seems to be the issue?
User: Professor, I appreciate your time. Due to unexpected family circumstances and a technical failure that corrupted my initial draft, I've fallen behind schedule, but I'd like to request a two-week extension to deliver work that meets your standards.
Person: I understand, but you're aware that extensions set a precedent. What guarantee can you provide that this won't compromise the quality of your research?
User: I'm prepared to submit detailed progress notes every three days and a comprehensive outline by next Friday to demonstrate commitment. Additionally, I'll include supplementary sources that weren't in my original plan.
Person: That's a reasonable proposal. However, I can only grant this extension if you understand it's conditional upon those check-ins and if you submit the final version no later than two weeks from today.
User: Absolutely. I'm grateful for your understanding, and I assure you this extension will result in a significantly improved submission.

title: Consultar sobre síntomas persistentes y opciones de tratamiento
description: Segunda visita al gastroenterólogo y los síntomas siguen igual. Quieres cuestionar el tratamiento actual y pedir pruebas y alternativas.
objective: Debes describir con detalle tus síntomas (dolor abdominal después de ciertas comidas, fatiga durante el día, inflamación ocasional), cuestionar la efectividad del tratamiento actual, solicitar pruebas adicionales específicas (endoscopia, análisis de intolerancias alimentarias) y discutir enfoques alternativos como cambios dietéticos o terapia complementaria.
scene_context: Estás en la consulta privada de un gastroenterólogo especializado. Es tu segunda visita y quieres tomar un papel más activo en tus cuidados.
expected_outcome_indicator: Clearly articulates symptoms, questions current treatment, and negotiates comprehensive diagnostic plan.
example_conversation:
Person: Welcome back. I see you've been on the prescribed medication for three months now. How are you feeling overall?
User: To be honest, the improvement has been minimal. I still experience significant abdominal pain roughly two hours after eating certain foods, and I'm noticing persistent fatigue throughout the day, which is affecting my work performance considerably.
Person: That's concerning. Have you noticed any particular foods that trigger these symptoms more than others?
User: Yes, actually. High-fat foods and dairy products seem especially problematic. Given these patterns, I'm wondering whether we should pursue more advanced testing, such as an endoscopy or food intolerance analysis, before continuing with medication alone.
Person: That's a reasonable request. An endoscopy could be useful, though it's more invasive. Regarding food intolerance testing, the scientific evidence is mixed. However, we could explore a structured elimination diet under nutritionist supervision alongside the endoscopy.
User: I appreciate that balanced perspective. Could you refer me to a qualified nutritionist who works with gastroenterologists? I'd like to take a more integrated approach combining medical investigation with dietary management.

title: Negociar condiciones de trabajo remoto en una empresa nueva
description: Entrevista final en Mitchell & Associates, en el centro de Londres. Antes de aceptar la oferta quieres defender tres días de teletrabajo.
objective: Convencer al jefe de proyecto (señor Mitchell) de permitirte trabajar desde casa 3 días a la semana, argumentando mejora en productividad y reducción de costos de transporte (tu desplazamiento es de 45 minutos), sin que esto afecte la colaboración presencial requerida los jueves y viernes en la oficina central de Londres.
scene_context: Estás en la oficina de Mitchell & Associates en el centro de Londres, sentado frente al director de Recursos Humanos después de recibir una oferta formal. Es tu última oportunidad para negociar los términos antes de firmar el contrato.
expected_outcome_indicator: Successfully negotiate hybrid work arrangement with concrete commitments.
example_conversation:
Person: Well, congratulations on the offer. Before you sign, are there any terms you'd like to revisit? I should mention that our procurement guidelines stipulate at least three office days per week for collaborative purposes.
User: I appreciate the opportunity genuinely, though I'd like to propose an alternative arrangement. Given that the commute from my current residence is forty-five minutes each way, working remotely on Mondays, Wednesdays, and one additional day would substantially mitigate travel costs while allowing me to maintain the in-person collaboration you require on Thursdays and Fridays.
Person: That's a fairly significant deviation from our standard discretionary policy. What's your rationale for believing this arrangement would enhance rather than hinder productivity?
User: Whereas I recognise your concern about cohesion, research indicates that knowledge workers report higher output when freed from commute fatigue, provided the channels for synchronous communication remain robust. Moreover, I'd be amenable to attending monthly in-person strategy sessions on Wednesdays to offset any liaison gaps.
Person: You've thought this through. I'll need to run it past the team leads, but I'm inclined to explore a pilot arrangement for the first quarter.

title: Cuestionar un diagnóstico médico vago y solicitar pruebas adicionales
description: Tercera cita con la doctora Chen y los síntomas siguen sin explicación. Quieres que te remita al especialista y que pida pruebas concretas.
objective: Persuadir a la doctora Chen de que remita tus síntomas (fatiga crónica, dolores articulares intermitentes y dificultad de concentración que persisten desde hace 8 semanas) a un especialista en medicina interna, argumentando que la hipótesis inicial de déficit de vitamina B12 (confirmada con análisis de hace 3 semanas) no explica completamente el patrón de síntomas, y solicitar específicamente un análisis de función tiroidea y autoinmunidad.
scene_context: En la consulta de la doctora Chen en la clínica privada Harley Street, Londres. Es tu tercera cita en dos meses y la doctora ha sugerido que los síntomas "mejorarán pronto" con el tratamiento actual.
expected_outcome_indicator: Secure specialist referral and additional diagnostic tests.
example_conversation:
Person: Your B12 levels have improved significantly since last month's supplementation. I think we should simply monitor progress and reassess in six weeks.
User: I appreciate the improvement in those specific markers, though I'm somewhat concerned that the constellation of symptoms—the fatigue, the migratory joint pain, and the cognitive fog—hasn't substantially abated despite the B12 intervention. While not discounting that deficiency as contributory, I wonder whether a thyroid panel and inflammatory markers might illuminate what appears to be a multisystem presentation.
Person: These symptoms are often psychosomatic, you know. Stress can manifest in numerous ways. Have you considered whether your work situation might be exacerbating things?
User: I don't wish to be dismissive of that hypothesis, though the onset predates any recent workplace changes, and the symptoms are quite tangible—my exercise tolerance has genuinely diminished. Given the duration and specificity of this presentation, wouldn't it be prudent to rule out autoimmune conditions before attributing everything to psychological factors? I'd be grateful for a referral to internal medicine.
Person: Fair point. I'll send you to Dr. Patel. He's thorough—perhaps overly so—but if anyone can get to the bottom of this, it's him.

title: Cuestionar la viabilidad de un proyecto académico y solicitar una prórroga justificada
description: El corpus de tu tesis (500 textos) es inabarcable con el tiempo que queda. Te reúnes con tu supervisor Holbrook para reducir alcance o fecha.
objective: Convencer al profesor Arthur Holbrook de reducir el corpus de análisis de tu tesis de máster de 500 textos históricos (período 1840-1920) a 250, o alternativamente, extender la fecha de entrega del 15 de junio al 30 de julio, demostrando cálculos concretos de tiempo (60 horas estimadas de análisis textual vs. 22 horas disponibles hasta la fecha límite) e indicando que la calidad se verá comprometida si no se hace.
scene_context: En el despacho del profesor Holbrook en la facultad de Humanidades de la Universidad de Oxford, después de su seminario semanal. Ha quedado claro que espera que mantengas el cronograma original sin excepciones.
expected_outcome_indicator: Negotiate scope reduction or deadline extension with evidence-based argument.
example_conversation:
Person: I've reviewed your progress notes, and frankly, I'm a bit concerned about your pace. We're eight weeks from submission, and you've only processed roughly one hundred and thirty texts. The thesis committee expects the full analytical scope.
User: I understand the expectation, Professor, and I'm not seeking to circumvent the rigour the committee demands. However, I've calculated that comprehensive thematic and linguistic analysis of the remaining three hundred and seventy texts would necessitate approximately sixty hours of intensive work, whereas my current schedule—balancing my research assistant duties and coursework—realistically permits only twenty hours over the remaining period. Should I proceed at this pace, I risk producing superficial analysis that would undermine the dissertation's credibility.
Person: Well, you knew the scope when you proposed it. Expanding your hours isn't really my problem.
User: You're absolutely right that I designed the methodology, though circumstances have shifted since September when I underestimated the depth required for the comparative framework. I'm not asking to diminish rigour; rather, I'm proposing either a reduction to two hundred and fifty carefully selected texts that preserve geographical and temporal representation, or a four-week extension that would allow the thoroughness you've taught me to value. Which would the committee find more acceptable?
Person: An extension is tricky, but a reduced corpus with properly stratified sampling... that could work. Send me a revised methodology by Friday.

title: Informar sobre un comportamiento inapropiado en el lugar de trabajo y solicitar mediación
description: Un colega senior hizo comentarios sobre tu acento en una reunión y te incomodó. Quieres contárselo a Sandra Mills sin abrir un caso formal de RRHH.
objective: Comunicarle a tu jefa directa, Sandra Mills, que tu colega senior analyst David Rosenthal ha hecho comentarios potencialmente discriminatorios e inapropiados sobre tu acento durante una reunión de equipo del martes (específicamente, sugirió que "tu pronunciación ralentiza la comunicación"), y solicitar que se aborde mediante una conversación confidencial entre ustedes tres, sin iniciar un procedimiento de recursos humanos formal que podría afectar la dinámica del equipo de 8 personas.
